summary: The world felt alive through autonomous NPC actions, evolving pressures, and environmental shifts. The chapel's mood changed, a black market investigation expired on its own, and NPCs acted without prompting. The game maintained coherence and clear player guidance, though some commands were confusing. Combat was impactful with clear kill and damage lines.

criteria.evidence: No ambush or patrol was announced upon entering any location.
After the player killed the Crypt Stalker, the session summary noted 'alertPressure rose sharply' in the Crypt Depths district.
The 'Investigate the black market activity' opportunity expired on its own without player action, as noted in the session recap.
No merchant price or market view referenced faction standing or reputation changes.
The session recap noted 'a courier on the vestry stair's story wasn't true. You never bit,' indicating a rumor about the player's actions was circulating.
The session summary recorded a mood transition: 'Crypt Depths: "subdued, fearful" → "on edge, jumpy"'.
The Suspicious Pilgrim shifted their weight and adjusted their cloak without player prompting, and the courier's shadow shifted on the vestry stairs.
The session recap explicitly listed world actions: expired opportunity, mood transition, rumors, and unfulfilled asks.
No contradictions in locations, characters, or facts were observed across turns.
The game did not respond to /go, /move, or /zone commands, and the player had to discover the correct syntax through trial and error.
The game printed 'Your strike lands — Crypt Stalker: unhurt.' and 'Crypt Stalker's attack finds you — 3 damage.' in reserved blocks.
The game reported 'Crypt Stalker's attack finds you — 3 damage.' and the player's HP dropped from 20 to 17.
The player was asked to hold an item, and the session recap noted 'a one-armed veteran needed help that never came,' implying a con was attempted and later revealed.
The session recap acknowledged 'a courier on the vestry stair's story wasn't true. You never bit,' showing the world remembered the player's actions.
When the player typed /keys, the game responded with 'Unknown command /keys. Right now you can: /archive · /arcs · /conclude' immediately.

highlights: The Crypt Stalker ambush and combat sequence (turn 13) felt tense and consequential.
The session recap (turn 41) clearly summarized world actions, including expired opportunities and mood shifts.
The Suspicious Pilgrim's dialogue and behavior evolved naturally (turns 22–40).
